title: Gemini to connect with tons of new apps, including Pandora and OpenTable
content_html:
Gemini is making new friends.

Google announced tons of new hardware during yesterday's Made by Google event, but that doesn't mean the company's AI didn't get a slew of important updates of its own.

Among them was the announcement that Gemini will soon be able to connect with a number of third-party apps. The list is quite long and includes productivity, health, lifestyle, entertainment, and home apps. Here's the list in full:

Mashable Light Speed

  • Granola

  • Otter.ai

  • Wix

  • Fever

  • GetYourGuide

  • Localize

  • OpenTable (UK)

  • Ticketmaster

  • iHeartRadio

  • Pandora

  • Angi

  • Thumbtack

  • Zocdoc

In practice, you should be able to book a dinner reservation, a concert later that same day, and get a related Pandora playlist, all without leaving a convo with Gemini. Pretty sweet.

Google says that the ability for Gemini to connect with these will be rolled out "over the next weeks."

In related news, Google also said that Gemini has more than 1 billion monthly active users. That means it grew faster than any other product in the company's history, including search.

content_html_zh:
双子座正在结交新朋友。

谷歌在昨天的 Made by Google 活动中宣布了大量新硬件，但这并不意味着该公司的人工智能没有获得大量重要的更新。

其中包括宣布 Gemini 很快就能与许多第三方应用程序连接。 这个列表很长，包括生产力、健康、生活方式、娱乐和家庭应用程序。 以下是完整列表：

可混搭光速

  • 格兰诺拉麦片
  • Otter.ai

  • Wix

  • Fever

  • 获取您的指南
  • 本地化
  • OpenTable（英国）
  • 票务大师
  • 爱心电台
  • 潘多拉

  • Angi

  • 图钉
  • 佐克多克

实际上，您应该能够预订晚餐、当天晚些时候的音乐会，并获得相关的潘多拉播放列表，所有这些都无需离开双子座的车队。 相当甜蜜。

谷歌表示，Gemini 与这些设备的连接能力将在“未来几周内”推出。

相关消息中，谷歌还表示，Gemini 每月活跃用户超过 10 亿。 这意味着它的增长速度比公司历史上任何其他产品（包括搜索）都要快。
